# instana

**Tag**: library

## 简介

The Instana gem is a zero configuration tool that will automatically collect key metrics and distributed traces from your Ruby processes. Just install and go.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.instana.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/instana/ruby-sensor
- 文档: https://docs.instana.io/ecosystem/ruby/
- 更新日志: https://github.com/instana/ruby-sensor/releases
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/instana
